declared.description: Submit the scientific reason and the operation to enact. Select delivered measurements by their exact row keys in metric_refs. GX binds their sources and the matching registered comparison, fills unique branch fields and wakes on Job results. With multiple matches, select from the comparison_id options in the reply. Legacy explicit fields remain valid. Example: {"decision":{"rationale":"The calibration residual leaves the drift estimate uncertain; measure the second standard.","metric_refs":["<delivered row key>"],"ops":[{"op":"add_node","capability":"<listed method@version>","inputs":["<second calibration standard ref>"],"parameters":{"channel":"<method-supported channel>"},"question":"Does drift persist on the second standard?"}]}}
